rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MemProcFS-mcp-server provides a bridge between AI assistants and memory forensics capabilities through the MemProcFS Python library. The server exposes tools for analyzing process attributes, registry hives, keys and values from memory dumps, making it valuable for digital forensics investigators who need to examine Windows memory images through natural language interaction. Built with FastMCP, it features robust error handling and comprehensive documentation of available process and registry attributes.
